label: If the selected rigid n exists at every root-accessible world, its degree at every such world is…
paraphrase: If the selected rigid n exists at every root-accessible world, its degree at every such world is order-equivalent to its degree at the standpoint: both inequalities hold. This conditional does not assert necessity of n, literal identity of degree labels, or actual presence from necessity on a nonreflexive frame. This is an analyst condition, kept separate from the actual-presence-guarded source reading; on a nonreflexive frame its antecedent can hold even when n is absent at the standpoint.
